name: Schelling's line: restricted travel
description: Schelling's restricted movement: a 20 % minority on a line of 70 may pass at most this many people, accepting three alike of eight within reach when half is not to be had (0: no limit, and no fallback). Schelling: "everybody achieves his desired neighborhood … without traveling as far as if he and the others had been free to travel" (he does not give the radius). Measured (release, seeds 1–20, recorded 2026-09-29), mean share unsatisfied at round 50: 15 % passing at most 2, 10 % at 5, 6 % at 10, 3 % at 20, 2 % at 30, and 3 % with no limit.
